data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, CRITICAL — SUPERSEDES paths/keys in original ACs): (1) TEST PATH: plugins/dso/tests/ does NOT exist. The new test file is tests/hooks/test-planning-config-call-site-threshold.sh (repo-root tests/ tree, alongside existing tests/hooks/test-planning-config.sh). Update every AC Verify: command that references plugins/dso/tests/... to this repo-root path. (2) CONFIG KEY NAMESPACE: get_call_site_threshold() lives in planning-config.sh but MUST read the key 'migration.call_site_threshold' verbatim (the epic Success Criterion + task-5 doc + the contract require migration.*, NOT planning.call_site_threshold). read-config.sh reads any key regardless of the helper's home file, so reading migration.call_site_threshold from planning-config.sh is correct and required for the override to take effect.
